decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis app is promoted as a new product line on its own page and fits the firm's dental practice software core, so its value is still unresolved and it costs little to keep open with strong growth potential.
The continuing education institute supports customer loyalty around the core dental software business, and after only one year there is too little evidence to justify abandoning this low-cost option.
The remote support tool is a cheap add-on that likely serves the firm's own customer support, so keeping it costs little even though it is only mentioned on the website.
